differences.what: A module, exam_abdominal, that the General note type includes: its section Abdominal / GI shows only while Abdominal (exam.systems is abdominal) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10

differences.what: Inspection is choose-many. Flat is the normal option and is not exclusive: a flat abdomen can have scars, bruising or a hernia. Flat excludes Distended and Protuberant.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 13, 17, 26 (a reading of default 13: Flat describes the abdomen's shape, not all of it)

differences.what: Bowel sounds is choose-one. Normal is the normal option; Unable to assess is neither normal nor abnormal.
Tenderness is choose-many. None is the normal option and clears the others. The codes follow the rule: right_upper_quadrant_ruq and the like.
Pain Severity is a whole number from 0 to 10, shown out of 10, and only while a tenderness is picked. Normal leaves it empty.
Peritoneal signs is choose-many. None, written last, is the normal option and clears the others.
Mass is choose-one: None (the normal option) or Present.
Location is a short text, Mass location, shown only while Mass is Present.
Organomegaly is choose-many. None, written last, is the normal option and clears the others.
Other findings is choose-many with no normal option: Normal leaves it empty. Other asks for a short text. CVA tenderness stays here and in GU, as written.
